_note: Foamer rigs for the sandbox (sandbox.html), one per roster role in design/CONTENT-PLAN.md section 3. F01, F02 and F05 use the ART-03 designs. The other shapes and proportions remain greybox placeholders for discussion, not final designs. Sizes in voxels (0.05 m). 'at' is where a part's joint sits on its parent's box and 'pivot' where it sits on the part's own box, both -1 to 1 per axis (0 centre, 1 the +x / top / front face). 'rest' is a rest rotation in radians. Feet are put on the ground automatically.

rigs.label: Slowmer
rigs.behaviour: Slow, walks at you in groups. Bonks up close. Free finishers.

rigs.label: Roamer
rigs.behaviour: Agile, keeps its distance, throws slow parryable foam balls.

motions._note: ANIM-01: the Roamer's throw, from the load to the follow. Part rotations and root lean and turn in degrees, k 0..1 within each state; there is no recover block, the recover state eases back to rest on its own. wind: armR swings the ball arm overhead and back, foreArmR straightens the elbow so the ball sits behind the head, turn swings the body a little away from the target, head and roll drop the throwing side. strike: the arm whips forward past the shoulder and the body turns through. The values keep the ball's arc up and behind in the wind and level and out in front in the strike (checked with tools/throw-probe.ts).

rigs.label: Swarmer
rigs.behaviour: Small and fast, comes in packs of 4 to 6. Nibbles, then darts back out.

motions._note: GAME-10d: the Swarmer's poses, degrees and metres, read by src/foamers/rig-states.ts. nibble: the mouth snap (the head lunges and bites down). backOut: the hop out after a nibble (the body rears up and springs back).

rigs.label: Blocker
rigs.behaviour: Holds a shield wall and fires over it. Flank it or shield-charge it.

rigs.label: Darter
rigs.behaviour: Charges in a straight line. Armoured front, weak back.

motions._note: ANIM-01: the Darter poses, replacing the GAME-10b placeholders. Angles in degrees, distances in metres; the scrape's cycles are whole number of strokes so the leg is at rest when the telegraph ends, and the state edge never jumps. The wall stun's headShake is a fast pitch shake of the whole body: this rig has no separate head part, its body is its head.

rigs.label: Floater
rigs.behaviour: Floats slowly and spits bouncing blobs. Stagger it with a big hit.

rigs.label: Brawler
rigs.behaviour: Melee brawler. Leaps and slams down with a shockwave.

motions._note: GAME-10f: the Brawler poses (crouchMotion / leapMotion in rig-states.ts). Angles in degrees, distances in metres; the crouch is eased over its whole seconds and the leap pose is set by the launch, so both start and end at rest.

rigs._note: GAME-10f: the Brawler look in the factory palette (ART-03 way): purple body, orange armour pads, lime fists. [Paul] CONTENT-PLAN 3 says uses a foam sword, the 3.3 greybox row says huge fists: this card keeps the fists and colours them lime (the sword's colour). Sword or fists: Paul to choose.

rigs.label: F08
rigs.behaviour: Slow tank. Fires walls of foam balls with gaps to slip through. Two arm launchers.

rigs.label: F09
rigs.behaviour: Turret walker on four legs. Sustained fire from a gun you can shoot off.

rigs.label: F10
rigs.behaviour: Flies on jets and fires homing foam. Shoot the jets and it falls.

rigs.label: F11
rigs.behaviour: Elite: a hulking armoured knight. Tower shield only a parry breaks; three-hit mace combo ending in a parryable finisher.

rigs.label: F12
rigs.behaviour: Hides low, creeps, then pounces from cover.

rigs.label: F13
rigs.behaviour: Support: sends foam to rebuild other Foamers. Shoot its tank first.
